blocks.text: Luxury Homes in Mission – Explore Properties Over $1.8 Million

parts.t: Mission's luxury market over $1.8M showcases impressive waterfront estates, executive properties, and custom homes offering space and quality in stunning natural settings. These premium properties attract discerning buyers seeking Fraser Valley lifestyle without compromising on finishes, amenities, or architectural distinction.

The luxury segment includes exceptional lakefront estates with private docks on Hatzic or Stave Lake, hilltop properties with panoramic mountain and river views, plus custom builds on larger acreages offering privacy and room for hobbies. Buyers appreciate Mission's outdoor recreation access with hiking, water sports, and nature activities year-round, combined with improving town amenities and reasonable commuting via Highway 7. Properties feature high-end kitchens, spa-like bathrooms, outdoor entertaining spaces, and often unique features like wine cellars, home theaters, or professional workshops. Despite luxury positioning, Mission maintains authentic community atmosphere and relaxed pace. These properties offer exceptional value compared to similar Metro Vancouver estates.
